acceptanceCriteria: An accepted profile defines the symbol identity form, its resolution to pinned spans, and the abstention when resolution fails or is ambiguous.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

The provider record contract addresses evidence by path and line span only. Issue #64 asks for a symbol-level identity (`repository-id:symbol`) so a provider can answer about a function or type without a line pin, with the consumer resolving it to a pinned span at the target revision. This needs an accepted profile before any transport accepts it.
title: extevidence: no symbol lookup or `repository-id:symbol` identity in the provider contract
